datasetId.title: Source dataset
datasetId.description: Dataset of job rows to enrich. Declared as a dataset resource so the platform grants read access — a plain string id is refused with ForbiddenError. When this Actor is connected as an integration the platform supplies it.

urlField.title: URL field
urlField.description: Which column holds the posting URL. Leave empty and the common names are tried (jobUrl, url, applyUrl, absolute_url, hostedUrl, link), then any value that parses as a board URL.

maxRows.title: Row cap
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows. An integration fires on someone else's schedule, so the ceiling has to be yours.

keepSourceFields.title: Keep the source columns
keepSourceFields.description: Merge the original row into the output instead of returning only lifecycle fields.
